weaknesses.text: The low roof and small windows reduce outward visibility in the sixth-generation coupe.

driving.text: The V6 manual has a light-feeling nose and a satisfying shift. Visibility remains tight and it has less midrange occasion than the SS.

styling.text: A low roof and tight rear quarters give it stance. The high sides and small windows look heavy.

character.enthusiastAppeal: The Alpha chassis combines muscle-car proportions with precise placement.
character.idealBuyer: A driver who wants a manual coupe and can live with limited sightlines.
character.avoidIf: You need good outward visibility or regularly carry rear passengers.
